exposure: Desire to feel better after birth
outcome: Sense of control over birth decision
cohort: 10 women with experience of one previous caesarean section and eligible for VBAC.
finding: Factors influencing women's decision-making for VBAC are primarily rooted in 'Self-determination' (driven by knowledge, strong will, previous experience, and desire for well-being) and 'Self-confidence' (influenced by self-belief and care provider support).
mod_finding: Participants reported a sense of control and satisfaction with their decision regarding mode of birth, irrespective of the actual birth outcome.
